findings.title: Missing /api/farmacia/medicamentos endpoint
findings.description: Hook useMedicamentos() calls /api/farmacia/medicamentos but this endpoint does not exist. Verified with file search - no src/app/api/farmacia/ directory exists.
findings.impact: Any component using useMedicamentos() will fail with 404 errors. The SWR cache system for medications is non-functional.

findings.title: Missing /api/ccz/animais endpoint
findings.description: Hook useAnimaisCCZ() calls /api/ccz/animais?q=... but this endpoint does not exist. Search functionality for CCZ animals will fail.
findings.impact: Components using useAnimaisCCZ() for search will fail with 404 errors.

findings.title: Missing /api/junta-reguladora/servicos endpoint
findings.description: Hook useServicosJunta() calls /api/junta-reguladora/servicos but this endpoint does not exist.
findings.impact: Junta Reguladora module components using this hook will fail with 404 errors.

findings.title: Unused thumbnail parameter in CadastroAnimal.js
findings.description: Code requests thumbnailSize: 200 but doesn't pass generateThumbnail: true, and never uses the returned thumbnail variable. This is wasteful but not a blocker since the refactor correctly made thumbnail generation optional.
findings.impact: Negligible - just unnecessary code that doesn't affect functionality.
